notes.126r.15: Pantacher is unexplained, perhaps a form of Pantocrator; Eloy, primellus and primelli are kept as they stand. 'Lord, how are they multiplied' and 'O God, [come] to my help' are psalm openings (Ps 3, Ps 69/70) cued by their first words.

nodes.text: deliver me and hear me. The Our
Father. 'Lord, how are they multiplied.' Now look
at the feet and say: Lord
Jesus Christ, Eloy, by the three names which
you had before you were born,
deliver me from the tribulation that threatens,
and from all the people on account of whom
I petition you, from their hearts, not from their
souls. The Our Father. 'O God, [come] to my
help.' Lord Jesus Christ, I pray
you by your holy feet, with which upon
the sea you walked, and the head of the serpent
of old you trampled before the gate of paradise:
Christ, in this tribulation make my heart
glad, concerning that matter, N., for which
